about: The emulator's model (ADR-0022). Codes, tiers, sizes and timings only, each with the evidence that observed it; never market data. Column names and kinds come from docs/endpoints/schemas.json and refusals from docs/endpoints/status.json. Never updated automatically: a change is a reviewed pull request citing its run.

free.evidence: PROD login, FREE account: subscriptions 0 (CLI auth, 2026-11-01; docs/subscription-testing.md)

concurrency.evidence: limit: the vendor's documented FREE limit, the default (Coordinator, 2026-11-13: stricter than observed is the safe direction for tests). observed: p0 served 3 simultaneous tiny requests on FREE and never probed above 3 (docs/performance/p0-results.md); a test opts in with Concurrency::Observed. RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED over a limit was never observed live

options-pro.evidence: PROD login, options PRO and stocks/indices FREE: options 3, others 0 (2026-11-04; docs/requirements/beta1-evidence-review.md)

concurrency.evidence: the vendor's documented PRO limit (Tier::concurrency). RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED over it was never observed live: the over-limit probe was dropped (ADR-0021)

response.evidence: synthetic default, not an observation: small enough for every test. Config::recorded_sizes uses message_sizes instead

flat_file.evidence: a flat file streams as data throughout, with no manifest and no error (step G, 2026-11-05, docs/architecture/options-phase.md). The live files held 2.0-13.8 million rows; these counts are scaled down

not_found.evidence: NOT_FOUND before data for an unknown symbol and for a range with no trading days, with the same code, details and message (err-notfound-001, 2026-11-11; weekend and holiday ranges, *-a2-001, 2026-11-02). The emulator treats a symbol starting with the prefix as unknown, and a range of weekend days only as empty (holidays are not modelled)

first_row_delays.evidence: every strike x tick or 1 s quotes: 59.4-71.8 s before the first data, whatever the window or row count (opt-sizes-002, 2026-11-05, docs/architecture/options-phase.md)

terminal.evidence: heartbeats about once per second (vendor documentation; ADR-0018). First quote 1,032 ms after a single-contract subscribe, live (2026-11-10; a dev bulk subscribe took 1.5 s). Quotes: 1,682/s over 10 contracts on the dev feed (w10-dev-10-001). Full trade stream: 481 trades/s across the close run-up, each with a quote and an OHLC (w10-live-full-close-001; dev feed counts QUOTE/OHLC/TRADE). Every stream request, unsubscribes included, answered REQ_RESPONSE SUBSCRIBED (2026-11-10). REST answers 200, then 478 once another login ends the Terminal's historical session (w10-conflict-001). full_trade_contracts is synthetic

message_sizes.evidence: 1,820 messages of options W5c and W6c, none above 1 MiB, the largest 378,470 bytes (opt-msgsize-001, 2026-11-10, docs/performance/eod-transport-buffering.md). Each bucket is served at its middle size
